_about: Cases of `[text](url)` read by BOTH Markdown engines: frontend/src/test/markdown.test.jsx (MarkdownText) and core/tests/unit/test_email_note.py (the email note's _md_inline). `href` is the target of the first link once HTML entities are decoded, or null when the target is no link. Only cases both engines answer alike belong here: a site path or an absolute URL of this site is internal in the browser and external in an email, and a bare address is linked only by the browser. New cases go in this file, not in either test.
